oil.title: Oil Products / Stock
oil.subtitle: Essential, carrier, blended and macerated oils — litre/kg entries are converted automatically to a per-ml/gram unit cost.

soapCream.title: Soap / Cream Products
soapCream.subtitle: Natural soaps, creams and care products — gram/kg and ml/litre convert automatically; the unit cost is calculated by the quantity sold.

other.title: Other Products
other.subtitle: All products that do not fit a category — flexible group, variation and measure — units, gram/kg and ml/litre — the unit cost is calculated automatically.
other.variantHint: You can open a separate stock row for variations such as size, colour or model.

accessory.title: Prayer Beads / Jewellery / Accessories
accessory.subtitle: Colour, size and model variations are kept as separate stock rows; sales are per unit, and cost and profit are calculated automatically.
accessory.variantHint: Open a separate row for each colour / size / model of the same product (e.g. Tiger's Eye Bracelet | 18 cm | Brown).
accessory.unitHint: Calculated once the purchase cost and stock count are entered.
